title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Assessment: Missing Sides and Angles
description: Demonstrate mastery of 30-60-90 triangle side relationships, angle relationships, and correspondence.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has short leg 11. What is the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is twice the short leg. Since x = 11, 2x = 22.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has hypotenuse 34. What is the long leg?
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is 2x. If 2x = 34, then x = 17. The long leg is x\sqrt{3} = 17\sqrt{3}.

questions.question: The side opposite 60 degrees in a 30-60-90 triangle is 14\sqrt{3}. What is the side opposite 30 degrees?
questions.explanation: The side opposite 60 degrees is the long leg x\sqrt{3}. If x\sqrt{3} = 14\sqrt{3}, then x = 14.

questions.question: A right triangle has one acute angle of 60 degrees. Which statement must be true?
options: The other acute angle is 45 degrees.
The other acute angle is 30 degrees.
The hypotenuse equals the long leg.
questions.explanation: The acute angles in a right triangle add to 90 degrees. If one is 60 degrees, the other is 30 degrees.

questions.question: An equilateral triangle with side length 24 is split by an altitude. What is the length of the shorter leg in one of the two right triangles?
questions.explanation: The altitude bisects the base of the equilateral triangle. Half of 24 is 12, which is the short leg of each 30-60-90 triangle.

questions.question: If the long leg of a 30-60-90 triangle is 10\sqrt{3}, then the hypotenuse is 20.
questions.explanation: The long leg is x\sqrt{3}. If x\sqrt{3} = 10\sqrt{3}, then x = 10, and the hypotenuse is 2x = 20.

questions.question: In a 30-60-90 triangle, the side opposite 30 degrees is longer than the side opposite 60 degrees.
questions.explanation: The side opposite 30 degrees is x, while the side opposite 60 degrees is x\sqrt{3}. Since \sqrt{3} is greater than 1, x\sqrt{3} is longer.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has hypotenuse 50. The short leg is ___.
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is 2x. If 2x = 50, then x = 25.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has short leg 13. The long leg is ___ (use sqrt notation if needed).
questions.explanation: The long leg is x\sqrt{3}. With x = 13, the long leg is 13\sqrt{3}.

questions.question: A classmate says that in a 30-60-90 triangle with hypotenuse 18, the long leg is 9 and the short leg is 9\sqrt{3}. Explain the error and give the correct legs.
questions.correctAnswer: The classmate switched the short and long legs. The hypotenuse is 2x = 18, so x = 9. The short leg is 9, and the long leg is 9\sqrt{3}.
questions.explanation: The short leg is opposite 30 degrees and equals half the hypotenuse. The long leg is the short leg times \sqrt{3}.
